description: Afference is a hardware-enabled software company at the forefront of Spatial Computing, which involves the digitization and interaction with real-world spaces through digital devices. It is poised to transform how users interact with digital content. Current input methods, such as hand tracking technologies lack any tactile feedback, which is crucial for sensory perception involving vision, sound, and touch. Afference addresses this gap with their innovative haptic device, “The Phantom”. This glovelet device creates an artificial sensation of touch through neurostimulation. Unlike existing bulky and tethered haptic devices, The Phantom is non-invasive, supports hand tracking, has a longer battery life than the average headset, and is compatible with any device, providing a truly immersive and dexterous experience.
tagline: Afference is building wearables that create tactile sensations using direct neural stimulation to enable digital interactions for the Spatial Computing era.

description: Akin develops advanced AI systems at the intersection of neuroscience, chaos theory, and AI, focusing on symbiotic AI that adapts dynamically to users and environments. The company creates AI solutions for various sectors, including healthcare, government, and space exploration, aiming to foster a future where AI and humanity coexist harmoniously. Akin's AI applications range from personal assistants for daily living to sophisticated analytics tools for clinicians, emphasizing ethical development and public benefit.
tagline: Akin is developing advanced AI models for a future where AI and humans coexist harmoniously, focusing on applications across healthcare, space, and daily living.

description: Through its versatile bioprinting platforms which can impact tissue engineering, organ-on-a-chip development, and pharmaceutical, Allevi empowers scientists to design and create complex tissue structures efficiently, advancing research in regenerative medicine and biomedical innovation.
tagline: Allevi is pioneering the field of 3D bioprinting by offering advanced bioprinters and bioinks that enable researchers to engineer living tissues for various applications.

description: All.Space aims to bring high throughput satellite communications to scale through radical price and performance disruption. All.Space is leveraging its optical technology to develop all-electric, multi-beam, low power, multi-frequency smart terminals at a fraction of today’s cost and with a step-change in performance.
tagline: All.Space provides multi-band, multi-orbit satellite antennas to connect next generation satellite and terrestrial communications networks.

description: Weather is one of the primary sources of risk on the planet directly affecting the livelihoods of over 2.5 billion people and 70% of all businesses. Parametric weather insurance is based on predetermined, verifiable, and objective metrics that customers choose at the beginning of their contract, such as yearly deviation in rainfall amounts or temperature. After deciding on a premium and selecting a payout amount, the end user relies on Arbol’s platform to handle the rest.
tagline: Arbol is developing an insurance marketplace that connects weather exposed entities with capital providers including insurers and asset managers. Arbol’s parametric insurance platform removes information asymmetry and reduces administrative costs by leveraging objective data from satellites and weather stations.

description: The landscape of internet connectivity is undergoing a significant shift with the emergence of satellite-based ISPs. Traditionally, remote and underserved areas have struggled with limited access to reliable internet due to the challenges of deploying and maintaining terrestrial infrastructure (like fiber optic cables). Armada aims to fill this gap by standing at the crossroads of space and terrestrial technology. By developing a full suite of AI-powered tools for edge computing, Armada is not only complementing Starlink's connectivity but also enhancing it with high-value industrial use cases in the most remote parts of the world. The company’s mission is to bridge the digital divide through a suite of dedicated industrial device solutions to unlock the power of real-time computing in any location across the globe.
tagline: Armada offers the world's first full-stack edge computing platform, enabling industries to leverage real-time AI and data processing in remote and underserved locations, enhancing connectivity and operational efficiency.

description: Astrobotic is pioneering lunar logistics and space robotics, offering end-to-end delivery services to the Moon for payloads and scientific instruments. The company provides a comprehensive solution encompassing spacecraft design, testing, launch, and lunar landing. Astrobotic's product lines include the Peregrine and Griffin lunar landers, which cater to a variety of mission needs, and the CubeRover, a modular planetary rover. With a focus on accessibility and innovation, Astrobotic aims to make lunar exploration more attainable and cost-effective for commercial, academic, and governmental entities.
tagline: Astrobotic is a pioneering force in space exploration, specializing in both lunar and terrestrial systems.

description: THESIS FIT
tagline: A radar system illuminated by satellites.

description: The company's Freedom™ platform allows operators to access real-time satellite data with a single integration, offering scalable and efficient support for spacecraft, from single missions to entire constellations. With over 50 active antennas in 20+ countries, ATLAS serves commercial, civil, and defense clients, driving down costs and accelerating data delivery from space to Earth, facilitating mission success and operational agility.
tagline: ATLAS Space Operations provides cutting-edge Ground Software as a Service (GSaaS) solutions, enabling seamless, secure communication for space missions through its global federated ground network.

description: At the center of the mobility revolution occurring over the past decade is ride sharing, when introduced by early players such as Uber and Lyft, it transformed the way we commute and interact with the environment around us. However, the lack of operational efficiency is a key reason why most mobility companies are not profitable today. Bliq is the first workflow tool for independent platform workers and aims to address a fragmented ecosystem that creates high idle and reduced earnings.
tagline: Bliq is building the operating system for the on-demand economy. Their platform boosts efficiency and productivity across multiple mobility services with the goal of becoming the standard workflow tool for independent platform workers.

description: Their technology offers high-speed, secure, and scalable communications across space, air, land, and sea. With capabilities like point-to-multipoint free-space optical communications and post-quantum encryption, BridgeComm enables seamless data transmission for government, enterprise, and space-based applications. Their infrastructure is designed to overcome the limitations of traditional communication networks, providing enhanced bandwidth and security for mission-critical operations. BridgeComm's solutions are crucial for supporting the growing demands of the space economy and terrestrial telecom sectors.
tagline: BridgeComm is advancing global connectivity through its innovative optical wireless communication (OWC) solutions.

description: Satellites underpin payments, power grids, transportation, weather forecasting, and secure communications, yet Canada has long depended on other nations to place and maintain those systems in orbit. Without domestic medium-lift capacity, the country cannot independently launch, place, or maintain its own complex spacecraft. Canada Rocket Company is building that capability at home: a sovereign, reusable launch system designed, built, and flown in Canada.
tagline: Canada Rocket Company is building sovereign launch capability with reusable methalox rockets designed, built, and flown in Canada. Its R-Series fleet runs on a single shared engine core, from the R-1 tactical pathfinder, capable of responsive launch in under 96 hours, to the reusable medium-lift R-2. The goal is to give Canada independent access to orbit rather than relying on foreign providers to decide when, and whether, its satellites fly.

description: ClearRoad is building infrastructure-lite congestion pricing solutions, a GPS app that could save cities millions and create new revenue streams for municipalities in the post COVID world. In addition to being a tool to manage traffic and respond to climate change, ClearRoad is also considering negative congestion pricing schemes for essential or marginalized workers, creating a new tool for cities to build equity with their poor/marginalized citizens. Empowering governments can help them respond to any crisis or changes to policies synchronously and tap into a myriad of solutions to traffic, funding, and mobility problems.
tagline: ClearRoad is developing a cloud- & GPS-based all-in-one road seamless tolling platform for any monetization program to keep the road well managed and to reduce congestion. Offerings include infrastructure-lite congestion and road usage pricing solutions that create new revenue streams to replace gasoline taxes.

description: Cognitive3D has identified an opportunity to collect spatial intelligence, leveraging virtual, augmented, and mixed reality devices as a vehicle for data collection. The technology provides an innovative approach to consumer research, which enables brands to develop better product strategy, and understand consumer behaviors through a unique quantitatively measured platform. In this new domain, analytics insights are exponentially more important for immersive content than traditional mobile applications, as users are actively participating in the experience, vs. passively consuming content.
tagline: Cognitive3D is building the spatial analytics platform to define new metrics for how people engage with extended reality applications, and their effects on human behavior. Through leveraging spatial data in XR applications, developers will be able to have the same level of analysis they have grown accustomed to in traditional mobile or web-based platforms.

description: dataplor provides cutting-edge location intelligence by integrating advanced AI, machine learning, and human validation to deliver accurate, up-to-date global POI data. The platform enables businesses to enhance decision-making, streamline operations, and optimize resource allocation through detailed insights into consumer behaviors and market trends. dataplor's comprehensive data covers over 250 million locations across 200 countries, supporting industries like retail, fintech, logistics, and real estate in their strategic planning and competitive analysis efforts, ensuring reliable and actionable location intelligence for global market expansion​.
tagline: dataplor empowers growth by offering comprehensive location intelligence for every public and commercial location in the world, spanning over 200 countries and territories.

description: dClimate aims to make climate data more accessible and reliable by directly connecting data publishers with data consumers under a modern architecture that is user-friendly and supports data immutability. The platform allows data providers and forecasting entities to monetize their work and establish domain variable standards that make consuming climate data simple enough for even the most casual user. dClimate is solving the inefficiencies of the existing climate data ecosystem and is becoming a source of truth for the businesses, farmers, multinational corporations, and governments who depend on this information to make important decisions.
tagline: dClimate is a decentralized network offering comprehensive climate data and analytics, enabling businesses and governments to measure, monitor, and mitigate climate risks for a sustainable future.

description: echo3D’s Content Management System (CMS), Content Delivery Network (CDN) and Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) are tailored for developers and content creators, providing them the convenience of streamlining their server setup, data pipeline creation, content management without having to develop any infrastructure from scratch.
tagline: echo3D is developing a 3D-ready cloud platform that helps content creators and developing teams to manage and deliver 3D/AR/XR content to apps and devices around the globe. It also has all the essential tools needed to prepare the content for delivery, allowing the users to focus solely on creating innovative 3D experiences and not concern themselves with the infrastructure.

description: Satellite communications underpin national security, connectivity, and economic resilience, yet the capability to build and operate a megaconstellation has sat with a handful of trillion-dollar companies. For most nations and enterprises, the choice has been to commit enormous capital or to depend on infrastructure that someone else owns and controls. Eclipse Space changes that: full constellation infrastructure built to each customer's requirements and operated under their control, produced through a fabless model that can stand up in-country production lines for sovereign customers.
tagline: Eclipse Space builds turnkey megaconstellation infrastructure for nations and enterprises: satellites, payloads, ground segment, and operations delivered as a complete system. Founded by the engineers who built and scaled Starlink, Eclipse runs a fabless model, owning the design and software stack while producing through manufacturing partners across North America, Europe, and Asia. The goal is to give nations and operators the ability to own and run constellation infrastructure on their own terms, a capability that until now belonged only to the world's largest space programs.

description: Initially used for military training and strategic planning, wargames have become indispensable tools for modern defense and intelligence operations. Leveraging applied AI and gaming principles, Exia Labs is developing next-gen wargames that dynamically adapts to changing world conditions with space as a critical domain, providing real-time insights and uncovering asymmetric conditions that power military strategists and enterprise leaders alike to gain significant operational advantages, with space as a critical domain.
tagline: Exia Labs is building applications to power global defense strategies through applied AI and games.

description: Fortastra builds compact, autonomous spacecraft that protect high-value assets in orbit. It's vehicles can close on a satellite, inspect what happened, escort a threat, and respond when distance isn't enough. Open-architecture autonomy lets them sense, maneuver, and coordinate when human operators can't stay in the loop. Founded in 2025, the company has flown two demonstration missions, most recently on SpaceX's Transporter-18.
tagline: Fortastra builds spacecraft to defend on-orbit infrastructure from growing threats. Combining commercial components and cutting-edge engineering into low cost, maneuverable systems that make orbital defense practical at scale.

description: Gaia AI is building the Bloomberg terminal for forestry. More specifically, their platform consists of two core product lines: high-quality carbon credits (generated from proprietary data collection methodologies) and forestry inventory management software. With an AI-based data platform that produces higher-fidelity datasets than competitors and a founding team withunique hardware/software expertise, Gaia AI plans to unlock the largest supply of natural-based carbon credits.
tagline: Gaia AI is developing an AI-based data platform with easy, scalable measure and analytical tools that leverages GPS, satellite imagery, and LiDAR to solve the challenges associated with carbon additionality by partnering with timber companies to help them manage their operations.

description: GHGSat provides global emissions monitoring services, currently for greenhouse gasses and ultimately for a range of air quality and other trace gasses from anthropogenic and natural sources. Monitoring services are delivered using a patented, proprietary multi-platform system for collecting emissions data, and unique algorithms ingesting both GHGSat and third-party data to generate valuable operational, environmental, health & safety, and regulatory insights.
tagline: GHGSat is developing a suite of products and custom analytics based on unique emissions measurements from its own satellite constellation and aircraft sensors, at a fraction of the cost of existing alternatives. The company’s measurements are collected using short-wave infrared light (SWIR) wavelengths compared to standard imagery’s visible light.

description: Globeholder builds AI agents that work like a research lab. Specialized agents form hypotheses, test them against data and physical constraints, and cross-check each other's reasoning before reaching a conclusion. Every step is traceable, so teams can audit how an answer was reached, not just accept it. The company focuses on capital risk allocation and project design in the construction and energy verticals, where decisions carry physical and financial consequences and unverifiable outputs aren't good enough.
tagline: Globeholder builds scientific AI agents that turn open-ended investigation into traceable, verifiable answers for high-stakes decisions in construction and energy.

description: The recent emergence of Large Language Models (LLM) has shown promising developments in building tools that can turn unstructured data into useful information that can be leveraged to automate many aspects of business operations. While public LLMs have shown promise in turning unstructured data into useful information, they are not secured or tailored to specific business contexts. Gradial aims to bridge this gap by providing a self-managed cloud infrastructure and security to automate LLM integration for enterprises, with industry-agnosticcapabilities that can be tailored to specific industries.
tagline: Gradial is developing a generative AI platform that enables enterprises to securely integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) with their own proprietary data. However, Gradial pivoted from engineering to focus on empowering sales and marketing teams to deliver reimagined customer experiences and drive personalization at scale.

description: Guardian RF is redefining satellite communications by delivering advanced RF signal intelligence solutions through mesh networks and multi-modal sensing technologies. Their platform integrates real-time connectivity with scalable RF analysis, empowering defense sectors with precision insights. Guardian RF’s roadmap includes developing proprietary satellites to enhance signal detection and intelligence capabilities, enabling seamless integration with ground networks for global, real-time RF surveillance and communication systems.
tagline: Guardian RF delivers advanced RF intelligence and connectivity solutions, integrating mesh networks and proprietary satellites for real-time, global signal detection and communication systems.

description: By fusing their data with other sources, HawkEye provides powerful analytical products for applications such as maritime domain awareness, spectrum mapping, and monitoring. HawkEye 360’s advanced tools help users across government, defense, and commercial sectors improve visibility of global activities and gain actionable insights into critical situations, from tracking illegal activities to enhancing national security​.
tagline: HawkEye 360 is pioneering space-based radio frequency (RF) data analytics with a unique satellite constellation that detects, processes, and geolocates a wide range of RF signals.

description: Earth observation provides global information for many industries such as oil & gas, maritime, logistics, and insurance. However, 75% of the time, traditional remote sensing systems are unable to provide imagery data due to clouds or lack of daylight. ICEYE has developed a synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging platform that solves this problem. Unlike traditional remote sensing companies, ICEYE is able to provide remote sensing imagery data at all times of the day and regardless of atmospheric conditions.
tagline: ICEYE operates the world's largest synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite constellation, providing near real-time, high-resolution monitoring of any location on Earth, aiding in decision-making for natural disaster response, security, and various commercial applications.

description: Although access to space has increased due to declining launch costs, transferring between orbits remains a significant hurdle. Impulse Space aims to change this with their game-changing infrastructure to enable nimble and cost-effective access to any orbit. Their breakthrough comes in the form of orbital maneuvering vehicles designed specifically for rapid and reliable last-mile payload delivery. These vehicles possess the remarkable ability to deliver multiple payloads to unique orbits with just a single launch.
tagline: Impulse Space is revolutionizing space infrastructure by addressing the challenge of efficiently moving payloads into higher energy orbits.

description: Space is becoming increasingly congested and contested, posing a threat to the safety, security and sustainability of space assets and operations. By developing new methods of calculating collision probability, better space weather modeling, optimizing spacecraft maneuvering, and fusing next-generation automation to every step of satellite operations and spaceflight safety, Kayhan’s platform effectively removes delays and errors from the critical path of response to high-risk events through the delivery of autonomous flight alerts, notifications, and decision plans directly to their customers and stakeholders.
tagline: Kayhan Space brings next generation autonomy to satellite operations and ensures spaceflight safety.

grants.name: SBIR/STTR awards (USAF, USSF, NASA; 7 Phase I + 1 Phase II, 2020-2024)

funding_notes: Verified domain kayhan.space (www redirects to kayhan.space; newsroom also at kayhanspace.com). Kayhan Space Corp., Boulder/Lafayette, Colorado, founded 2019, makes Pathfinder space-traffic coordination software. It raised a $3.7M seed (Dec 2021), co-led by Initialized Capital and Root Ventures, and a $7M seed extension (Sep 2023) led by Space Capital and EVE Atlas. Payload reports $11M raised to date across three rounds. SEC Form D filings show $4,383,379 (2021) and $6,799,994 (2023) in equity sold, about $11.18M in total. The Form D figures likely include an earlier undisclosed pre-seed or conversions. A separate 'Kayhan Space SPV1, LLC' filed a Form D in Feb 2026 for a $241,875 pooled-fund raise (first sale Oct 2025). It is unclear whether this is a secondary or part of a new round, and it is excluded from the total. No priced Series A announced as of Oct 2026. SBIR/STTR awards total $1.59M per sbir.gov.

description: Kepler offers a modern API that enables users to access high-speed data relay in low-latency, high-volume environments.
tagline: Kepler is revolutionizing space communications by building a satellite network that provides seamless, real-time connectivity for space-to-space and space-to-Earth communications.

description: Kognitive Networks is revolutionizing network management by bringing Software-Defined Wide Area Networking (SDWAN) and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) technologies to a broad array of industries and use cases. Targeting enterprises that have many locations and require seamless communication, Kognitive Networks provides a software-first, wireless-aware approach to optimizing connectivity across multiple networks, including LEO/GEO satellites and multi-carrier 4G/5G cellular networks. The integrated security features, connectivitycontrols, and unified system management enable enterprises to take advantage of the evolving wireless landscape to rapidly scale their business and network operations while reducingoperating and technology expenses.
tagline: Kognitive Networks has developed software capable of finding the best wireless networks and allocating available bandwidth to the highest value uses, with the visibility and control enterprises need to combat their growing needs.

description: LeoLabs provides a practical, cost-effective solution to space debris tracking, management, and mitigation. With a worldwide network of proprietary ground-based, phased arrayradars, LeoLabs is uniquely positioned to offer rapid orbit determination, early operational support, andongoing debris awareness at 10x the precision and 1% ofthe cost of traditional methods. The company spun out of Stanford Research Institute with an estimated $100M of intellectual property.
tagline: LeoLabs builds and operates a network of phased array radars to detect and track objects with high resolution, providing unparalleled services to maintain safe and sustainable operations in Low Earth Orbits (LEO).

description: LGND is building foundational AI infrastructure for Earth intelligence. The team previously built Clay, widely regarded as the leading open-source geospatial foundation model, and among the first to demonstrate how large transformer models could be applied to satellite and Earth observation data. LGND builds on that foundation with a full-stack platform for creating, storing, and serving geo-embeddings that make satellite data searchable, composable, and interoperable across time and space. This unlocks more than just cost and complexity reductions: it enables a step-change in the speed and scalability of insight generation, transforming Earth data from a slow, manual asset into a dynamic, real-time information layer, and allows analysts, developers, and AI agents to rapidly deploy geospatial applications without deep expertise.
tagline: LGND is building AI infrastructure to make Earth observation data searchable, composable, and real-time—turning satellite imagery into an intuitive, intelligent layer for analysts, developers, and AI agents.
location: Remote first - Bay Area, NY, & Copenhagen

description: Lunar Outpost aims to push the bounds of robotics and software in extreme environments, enabling a sustainable interplanetary presence. With thousands of products deployed on Earth, multiple contracted rides to the Moon, and oxygen making experiments on Mars, Lunar Outpost aims to anchor a thriving cislunar economy enabled by thousands of autonomous robots.
tagline: Lunar Outpost is a robotics company with products serving extreme environments on the lunar surface as well as terrestrial industries including environmental sensing and mining. Lunar Outpost has two contracted rides to the Moon (both the first in human history to their respective locations) and has sold thousands of sensor products on Earth.

description: Lux Aeterna is building foundational reentry infrastructure for the orbital economy. In a market where launch costs are falling but satellite platforms remain largely disposable, Lux introduces the first reusable satellite bus and reentry system designed for high-frequency, cost-efficient operations. Its vertically integrated platform, built on Mars-derived heat shield tech and modular payload bays, supports up to 15 missions with precision-controlled landings—unlocking rapid sample returns, industrial-scale microgravity manufacturing, and new R&D cycles across defense, pharma, and commercial sectors. By bridging the gap between scalable launch and repeatable reentry, Lux Aeterna is redefining mission economics and laying the groundwork for the next era of space-based operations.
tagline: Lux Aeterna is building reusable satellite and reentry infrastructure to power high-frequency, cost-efficient missions and unlock the next era of orbital logistics.

description: Made In Space is known for deploying the first 3D printer aboard the International Space Station (ISS) in 2014. Its innovations enable the construction of tools, components, and structures in space, reducing dependency on Earth-based supply chains and enhancing long-term space exploration capabilities.
tagline: Made In Space is a pioneering space manufacturing company that develops 3D printing and other in-space manufacturing technologies.

description: Matidor is a map-based project management and collaboration platform designed for field professionals. Global Field Services is a rapidly growing market and there is no easy way to keep track of the environmental impact, geospatial data, project costs and other operational and regulatory information that are critical for project managers and field workers. Matidor aims to become the ultimate location visualization and data collaboration tool that directly addresses the unique business needs in field services industries.
tagline: Matidor provides geospatial tools built for project management and team collaboration. It features powerful GIS integrations and visualization, streamlined team management, simplified financial management, and reporting.

description: With 14 billion cameras worldwide generating over 1 trillion photos annually, businesses are inundated with visual content. Computer Vision has emerged as a technology that allows companies to understand and utilize this data effectively and at scale. Mobius Labs SDKs use advanced algorithms for computer vision based on Deep Learning (DL) and proprietary training methodologies that reduce the time and data to get from pixels to insights. DL technology allows computers to understand images not just as a matrix of pixels but to connect different levels such as lines, simple geometric shapes to complex objects such as faces and cars. It gives computers a sense of hierarchical understanding of the content of images and with this knowledge, computers can recognize complex objects in images and are enabled to collect intelligence information.
tagline: Mobius Labs specializes in developing advanced multimodal AI technologies that integrate computer vision, audio recognition, and natural language processing (NLP). Their solutions enable detailed analysis and understanding of visual, audio, and text data, making it possible to interact with content in a nuanced way.

description: Muon Space builds, deploys, and operates turnkey satellite systems powering the accelerating $100B+ space infrastructure transition to LEO constellations and unlocking new use cases and markets in Climate and National Security. Founded by industry pioneers, Muon has built the industry’s best team and developed a modular, vertically integrated simulation, satellite, instrument and data IP stack.
tagline: Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data.
funding_notes: Muon Space (muonspace.com, the domain given in the input), Mountain View, CA; builds LEO satellite constellations and was founded in 2021 (CEO Jonny Dyer). Rounds: $10M seed led by Costanoa (Oct 2021), $25M Series A led by Radical Ventures (Aug 2022), $56.7M Series B led by Activate Capital (Aug 2024), $89.5M Series B1 led by Congruent (Jun 2025; only $44.5M of it is equity, the other $45M is credit facilities and is excluded), and $250M Series C led by Eclipse (Aug 2026). The company says total equity is 'more than $386M', which matches the sum of the sourced equity rounds. Acquired Starlight Engines (propulsion) in 2025.

description: Nanoracks offers services such as deploying small satellites, managing research payloads aboard the International Space Station (ISS), and operating the Bishop Airlock, the first commercial airlock on the ISS. Nanoracks is a key player in enabling space research and commercializing low Earth orbit by offering innovative, accessible space solutions.
tagline: Nanoracks is a private space company that specializes in providing commercial access to space

description: Neurophos addresses the growing demand for computational power in AI by pioneering a revolutionary Optical Processing Unit (OPU) using metamaterials, silicon photonics, and analog computing. The OPU’s Compute-In-Memory (CIM) architecture integrates memory and processing into a single unit, reflecting a design mimicking the brain’s efficiency, enabling rapid, energy-efficient processing directly within the memory array. This delivers unprecedented gains in processing speed, energy efficiency, and computational density. Simulations showed that their existing optical ‘transistors’—which are already 10,000× smaller than traditional ones— enable a chip delivering over 1 ExaOPS (one million TOPS), equivalent to a thousand GPUs. This is achievable using current technology, with no need for further miniaturisation or next-gen nodes.
tagline: Neurophos is pioneering the use of optical metasurfaces and silicon photonics to build a new era of ultra-fast, low-power AI inference.

description: THESIS FIT
tagline: Nine Fives builds networked, driverless RF test equipment for teams building next-generation spacecraft, drones, and wireless hardware. It was founded by two SpaceX engineers who lived the problem: CEO Noah Levy built the radios and phased-array calibration systems on Falcon 9, Dragon, and Starship, and COO Andrew Kurtz spent nearly a decade delivering aerospace hardware at SpaceX and Boeing. Their attenuators, switches, and power meters install no drivers and work within seconds of being plugged in, controlled over USB-C or Power over Ethernet through a web UI, REST API, or SCPI. The result turns a rack of test gear into a single, version-controlled source of truth engineers actually want to use.

description: By leveraging proprietary materials and agile development processes, Oxford Space Systems provides high-performance solutions for communication, earth observation, and IoT applications, supporting missions with their flight-proven technology and cutting-edge space structures.
tagline: Oxford Space Systems is pioneering the development of innovative deployable antennas for space, offering scalable and lightweight solutions that improve performance and stowage efficiency while reducing complexity and cost.

description: Panthalassa is building a global compute and energy platform in international waters. As AI compute demand accelerates toward terawatt-scale, traditional land-based data centers are constrained by land use, permitting, cooling, and energy availability. Panthalassa solves this by deploying autonomous, ocean-based power plants that combine low-cost renewable energy with embedded compute, storage, and satellite connectivity. Each node integrates Starlink-based comms, GPS, GPU-class chips, and sealed underwater housing, enabling a scalable, resilient, and secure alternative to terrestrial infrastructure.
tagline: Panthalassa is building a global compute and energy platform at sea—deploying autonomous, ocean-based nodes to meet soaring AI demand beyond the limits of land.

description: Planet offers seamless API access to vast amounts of high-resolution satellite data, allowing developers to integrate it into their applications efficiently to empower decision-making across industries like agriculture, forestry, urban planning, and disaster response. Planet’s innovation enables faster, cost-effective insights into global environmental and operational changes.
tagline: Planet is revolutionizing Earth observation with its fleet of small satellites that capture daily imagery of the entire Earth.
funding_notes: Automated public-source search (Brave web results, press/news pages verified against the company domain, SEC EDGAR Form D); rounds not found publicly may exist

description: Quantum Xchange’s core product, Phio TX™, is the only crypto-agile network security solution today capable of making traditional data and communication networks quantum-safe. Quantum Xchange has become the first vendor in the world to make Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) commercially viable by overcoming its previous distance and delivery limitations with their initial customer Verizon. Space Capital has provided the company with an introduction to both SpaceX and Iridium to explore rapid scale-up of their QKD capabilities.
tagline: Quantum Xchange is developing a point-to multipoint quantum key infrastructure across any medium that helps organizations stay ahead of the evolving threat landscape and that is enterprise-ready and deployable today.

description: Regrow is a multinational team of scientists, agronomists, engineers, and software developers committed to transforming the supply chain from farm to fork to ensure a prosperous future for people and the planet. Regrow aims to provide access to data-driven decision making tools promoting the adoption of climate-smart agriculture in the communities that need it the most. By concentrating exclusively on analytics, the company is able to develop high value-add applications while avoiding the costly hardware associated with data capture. By targetingthe agronomist rather than the farmer, Regrow gains a more receptive, higher margin customer. Regrow now features a highly comprehensive agronomy suite, including crop model, soil model, practices mapping, API for agricultural data, and scalable infrastructure. This allows the company to serve theentire agricultural supply chain.
tagline: Regrow is developing an integrated agriculture analytics platform that leverages satellite imagery, agronomic models, weather, and IoT data to provide conclusive insight to agronomists including precision crop mapping, stem to soil impact modeling, agronomic calibration, MRV action planning and agricultural site data analysis.

description: Synthetic Data is simulation-based engineered data that can help address the current challenges in AI by expanding and supplementing existing datasets that have gaps and issues. Rendered has built a developer framework that provides a Platform as a Service (PaaS) to support data scientists, engineers, and business innovators who want to embrace synthetic data to investigate, validate, and expand AI-based technology and business opportunities.
tagline: Rendered.ai has developed a platform to enable the production of physics-based synthetic datasets for enterprise AI training and validation.

description: Revolution Space's proprietary ion beam technology enables the creation of high-performance propulsion systems for satellites, transforming cost-effective satellites into highly capable systems. By focusing on scalability, efficiency, and cutting-edge designs, Revolution Space empowers commercial and government clients to conduct reliable, efficient, and affordable space missions. The company’s innovative approach enhances satellite performance and space operations, positioning them as a leader in the next generation of space technology solutions.
tagline: Revolution Space develops in-space propulsion technologies aimed at advancing space exploration.

description: The number of small vehicles collectively surpasses 1.5 billion globally, which is on par with the number of cars in the world. Nearly 37% of all road crash deaths every year involve powered two- and three-wheeled small vehicles. Roadio has built a software platform powered by front and back cameras with ultra-high-resolution that are agnostic to small vehicle models, enhancing safety with features like a digital rearview mirror, real hazard alerts, and forward collision warnings. This system offers 360-degree visibility using advanced computer vision and AI, functioning effectively both day and night.
tagline: Roadio is building an AI-powered safety platform to make small vehicles safer than cars.

description: Rocket Lab offers cost-effective, frequent launches with its Electron rocket, capable of delivering payloads to low Earth orbit (LEO). Rocket Lab's Photon satellite platform also supports in-space missions. With innovations like reusable rockets, Rocket Lab is a key player in advancing the commercial space industry and supporting small satellite deployment.
tagline: Rocket Lab is an aerospace company specializing in small satellite launch services.

tagline: RogueBeam builds vertically integrated phased-array systems, co-designing the RFIC, the antenna, and the system under one roof instead of stitching together generic off-the-shelf parts. It was founded by three of the engineers behind Starlink's user terminal and phased-array program: Kim Schulze (RF silicon), Ersin Yetisir (antenna), and Amir Agah (RFIC). By designing the chip and the aperture together for a specific mission, RogueBeam reaches a cost and performance envelope that only vertical integration makes possible, and sells that capability as deep co-development partnerships rather than a catalog of standard components.

description: SkyWatch is enabling a new era in geospatial intelligence by providing developers with the tools they need to efficiently and cost-effectively integrate Earth observation (EO) data into their applications and workflows. The company provides a modern API through which external users can access various types of EO data in high volumes and at fast throughput speeds. The company has two product lines: EarthCache, the simplest way to integrate EO data into any application, and TerraStream, an automated data distribution platform for satellite operators.
tagline: SkyWatch has developed an Earth Observation (EO) aggregation and data management platform to connect developers and GIS managers with one of the largest networks of satellite imagery providers to make geospatial data easy, fast, and affordable.

description: Earth serves as the foundation for human existence, yet its resources are under significant strain due to conventional food production methods. Based on these challenges, Solar Foods has developed an innovative method to produce food from electricity and air, creating sustainable supply of protein. The company’s mission is to end world hunger by liberating food production from the constraints of finite resources, extensive land use, and the unpredictability of climate and weather conditions involved in traditional agriculture.
tagline: Solar Foods is a food technology company on a mission to revolutionise global food production by growing food out of thin air.

description: SpaceX is a leading aerospace manufacturer and space transport company. It develops advanced rockets and spacecraft, including the Falcon and Starship series, aimed at reducing space transportation costs and enabling the colonization of Mars. SpaceX achieved significant milestones such as the first privately-developed spacecraft to reach orbit, the first commercial spacecraft to dock with the International Space Station, and the first reusable rocket. The company continues to innovate toward interplanetary travel and sustainable human presence on Mars. Aside from the exciting launch development, SpaceX’s story has evolved dramatically in the last three years. With the development of Starlink, the company’s satellite constellation, SpaceX has become not only the world’s fastest growing provider of launch services with $15B+ in contracts, but also, an internet company with global users.
tagline: SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft.

description: The Speqtral team has made significant progress to date both in terms of technical development and customer traction. Their core technology was demonstrated on a cubesat mission at the Centre for Quantum Technologies (CQT) in Singapore, a SGD100 million research facility dedicated to the development of quantum technology. SpeQtral is now collaborating with Toshiba bring Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) solutions to governments and enterprises in Southeast Asia.
tagline: SpeQtral seeks to leverage quantum technologies to offer a secure, scalable solution for distributing symmetric encryption keys using satellites as trusted key exchanging nodes.

description: Threaded is revolutionizing digital manufacturing for the space economy by replacing outdated tools with a dynamic, data-driven platform that streamlines complex workflows. By enabling manufacturers to modernize operations, Threaded reduces costs, enhances transparency, and accelerates production timelines. Its advanced tools empower space companies to scale and adapt to the unique demands of building and operating space-based assets in the rapidly evolving space industry.
tagline: Threaded transforms digital manufacturing for the space economy with a data-driven platform that streamlines workflows, reduces costs, and empowers scalable, efficient production of space-based assets.

description: Ursa Major is revolutionizing rocket propulsion by offering turnkey, 3D-printed engines for space launch and hypersonic flight. By focusing on the development of off-the-shelf, high-performance engines, Ursa Major addresses key bottlenecks in the space launch economy, enabling launch providers to bypass complex and costly in-house propulsion development. Their engines, which are lighter, more efficient, and more cost-effective, reduce time to market and organizational overhead for companies launching small satellites and pursuing hypersonic capabilities. Led by experienced engineers from SpaceX and Blue Origin, Ursa Major is transforming commercial space.
tagline: Ursa Major develops advanced propulsion systems for the aerospace and defense sectors, offering reliable, American-made engines for space launches, hypersonic vehicles, and national security applications.

description: Varda Space Industries leverages microgravity to manufacture high-value materials in orbit and return them to Earth. Their advanced technology platform supports pharmaceutical and industrial applications, facilitating innovative processes unattainable on Earth. Varda aims to revolutionize space manufacturing and re-entry logistics, enabling new commercial opportunities in low Earth orbit​.
tagline: Varda Space Industries utilizes microgravity to process materials in orbit, returning them to Earth to enable advanced manufacturing and life sciences applications.

description: For over two decades, the International Space Station (ISS) has anchored human activity in orbit, but its aging systems, high costs, and government-driven cadence highlight the limits of legacy platforms. Payload integration is slow, astronaut time is dominated by maintenance, and commercial users face restricted access. With the ISS nearing retirement, there is a pressing need for new orbital infrastructure built for diverse users on commercial timelines. Vast is addressing this by developing modular, crew-rated space stations optimized for usability, maintainability, and persistent operations. The company is vertically integrated across propulsion, avionics, life support, crew systems, and mission operations, enabling tighter control of station design and delivery. Its roadmap begins with Haven-1, the first free-flying commercial crewed station, and extends to Haven-2, a larger platform enabling continuous presence in orbit. Beyond hardware, Vast distinguishes itself by making habitability and human performance central to long-duration mission success.

Violet Labs was founded to make iterative hardware engineering an organized and seamless process. With similar backgrounds in aerospace hardware engineering, Lucy and Caitlin had years of experience in using tools that are complex and, while useful for their specific tasks, ultimately inefficient when the users have to deal with a dozen of them in a sophisticated workflow. When Lucy worked on technical project management at Amazon’s Project Kuiper, she recognized this pain point and decided to build a holistic solution to become the centraloperating system for hardware engineering and a single source of truth.
tagline: Violet Labs is building a cloud-based no-code integration platform functioning as a centralized repository for hardware engineers to link all tools and data in one place.

description: Operating at altitudes five times closer to Earth than satellites, World View's Stratollite® system provides high-resolution imagery and data over extended periods. By delivering persistent monitoring capabilities, World View enables enhanced insights at lower costs compared to traditional satellite systems.
tagline: World View is advancing the future of Earth observation and remote sensing through its innovative stratospheric balloon technology.

description: Traditional GPS systems is a vast market exclusively served by government systems. While revolutionary, they have serious limitations in precision, vulnerability to interference, and coverage inconsistencies, especially in remote or densely built environments. Xona Space Systems aims to redefine the standards of space-based PNT solutions. At the core of Xona’s innovation is the PULSAR constellation, a network of proprietary LEO satellites augmented by a suite of sophisticated ground-based technologies and patented signal design, providing reliable global PNT service that is 170x stronger signal than GPS and 2cm accuracy, while being far more resistant to common vulnerabilities like jamming and spoofing.
tagline: Xona Space Systems is building precise and protected navigation services anywhere on Earth.

description: York develops modular satellite buses and delivers integrated mission solutions that encompass spacecraft manufacturing, launch support, ground segment services, and on-orbit operations. Its standardized platforms scale across mission needs from commercial imaging and communications to complex civil and defense programs. By combining vertically integrated production with mission operations and global ground network capabilities, York reduces cost, accelerates deployment timelines, and enhances reliability relative to bespoke satellite providers. This full-stack approach positions York to serve government, commercial, and defense customers with repeatable, scalable access to space.

Zephr uses an ensemble optimization model that collectively harnesses errors from all mobile devices in the network. Before Zephr, the accuracy and error for each GPS data point was unique to its location solution. A networked solution not only improves each phone’s individual location solution, but also makes the network of data collected more accurate. The measurements made by networked devices have a consistent absolute accuracy observed independently. Users share their GPS errors with Zephr and, in return, they receive an optimized location solution to their mobile device. This means that Zephr does not need to transmit users location data helping ensure privacy for their customers.
tagline: Zephr provides a novel network-based approach to augmenting GPS through the use of AI-based computational methods. Zephr’s enhanced GPS is a stand alone product that will be provided as an SDK to allow any mobile app to upgrade their GPS accuracy from the current 3-5m range to less than 50 centimeters by embedding the feature.
